name: Service: gateways, refresh, workspaces and apps

verified.context: Gateway, workspace and refresh docs, Sept 2026

refs.title: What is an on-premises data gateway?

asg.ds: A local CSV or SQL Express
steps: Install the on-premises data gateway (standard mode) on your machine. Register it.
Add a data source (File or SQL). Map the report's data source to it in the semantic model settings.
Schedule refresh. Then stop the gateway service and trigger refresh: read the exact error.
Add a second admin to the gateway.
asg.exp: Refresh succeeds with gateway online and fails with a gateway-offline message when it is not.

steps: Create workspaces Northwind-Dev, Northwind-Test, Northwind-Prod. Publish to Dev.
Move the semantic model to a separate workspace "Northwind-Models" and make the report connect live to it (Desktop → Get Data → Power BI semantic models). Republish.
Grant Build on the model to a colleague and have them create a report in their own workspace.
asg.exp: One model, two reports in different workspaces. Deleting the report does not delete the model.

steps: Open refresh history and download the refresh log.
Set failure notifications to a colleague.
Configure refresh 8 times a day and note the Pro limit; then read the capacity limit in the settings tooltip.
asg.exp: You can name the daily refresh limit for Pro and for capacity.

steps: Create an App with two audiences: Managers (all pages) and Reps (one page only).
Add a navigation section and a link to an external page.
Publish, then update one visual, republish the report, update the App. Observe the difference.
asg.exp: Rep audience cannot see the manager page even by URL.

int.q: Personal mode vs standard mode gateway.
int.a: Personal: one user, no sharing, no DirectQuery, no dataflows. Standard: shared, clustered, supports DirectQuery/live and dataflows, needs a service account and admins.

int.q: How do you avoid 50 reports each with their own copy of the model?
int.a: Publish one certified semantic model in a models workspace, give Build to authors, and have every report live-connect to it. Use endorsement (Promoted/Certified) so authors find it.

int.q: Scheduled refresh keeps failing at 6:00 but works manually. Where do you look?
int.a: Gateway online status at that hour, source maintenance windows, credential expiry, the log around that time, timezone of the schedule, and whether the manual refresh used a different (cached) credential.

int.q: What is the difference between "Update app" and "Republish"?
int.a: Republish from Desktop updates the workspace content; Update app pushes workspace content to app consumers. Both are needed for consumers to see a change.

int.q: Where do you put a shared date table and shared measures so every team reuses them?
int.a: In the shared semantic model. Reports live-connected to it can add report-level measures but not tables, which forces consistency.

ass.q: A DirectQuery report to on-prem SQL requires:
ass.why: DirectQuery is not supported by personal mode.

ass.q: Live connection to a shared model lets you:
ass.why: Live connections are read-only on the model except report measures.

ass.q: Set up gateway refresh for a local CSV, break it, fix it, and document the three settings you had to touch in the Service.
ass.hint: Gateway mapping, data source credentials, schedule.

ass.q: Which workspace role is the minimum to publish an App?
ass.why: Contributors can publish reports but not apps by default.
